news_cards.title: Cabinet Approves GOBARdhan Scheme for Compressed Biogas
bullets: Kendra sarkar ne GOBARdhan yojana ko mana, jiska udeshya compressed biogas ka utpaadan hai
Is yojana ke liye 23,731 crore rupee ka outlay hai
Yeh yojana desh mein swachh urja ka utpaadan badhane mein madad karegi

news_cards.title: Agni-4 Ballistic Missile Ka Safal Pareekshan
bullets: Bharat ne Agni-4 ballistic missile ka safal pareekshan kiya hai
Is missile ki maark kshamta 4000 kilometer hai
Yeh pareekshan Odisha ke Chandipur mein kiya gaya tha

news_cards.title: BRICS Summit Ka Aayojan
bullets: BRICS summit ka aayojan kiya gaya hai
Is summit mein kai deshon ke neta shaamil honge
Yeh summit vyaapaar, nivesh aur anya mudiyon par charcha karega

news_cards.title: RBI Ne Naye Niyam Jari Kiye
bullets: RBI ne naye niyam jari kiye hain
In niyamon ke tahat loan recovery ke liye naye disha nirdesh diye gaye hain
Yeh niyam loan defaulteron ke liye bhi laagu honge

news_cards.title: National Handloom Day Ka Aayojan
bullets: National Handloom Day ka aayojan kiya gaya hai
Is din ko manane ke liye kai karyakram aayojit kiye gaye hain
Yeh din handloom utpaadakon ko sammaanit karna hai

news_cards.title: Environment Ministry Ne Naye Niyam Jari Kiye
bullets: Environment ministry ne naye niyam jari kiye hain
In niyamon ke tahat vanon ki raksha ki jaayegi
Yeh niyam paryavaran sanrakshan ke liye hain
